title: The Zero Slice of Quaternionic Real Bordism
summary: Using the Hill-Hopkins-Ravenel norm, one can produce a $Q_8$-spectrum $N_{C_2}^{Q_8} \text{MU}\mathbb{R}$, where $Q_8$ is the quaternion group. Working towards a computation of the slice spectral sequence for $N_{C_2}^{Q_8} \text{MU}\mathbb{R}$, we compute the zero slice of $N_{C_2}^{Q_8} \text{MU}\mathbb{R}$ and a bigraded subring of the $\text{RO}(Q_8)$-graded homotopy Mackey functors of this slice.
